notes.title: We've added a SoundCloud-style embeddable players to Odesi
notes.content:
You can export any project to an Audio Player like this:

http://player.odesimusic.com/904b38aa-c524-47f2-a7d0-9c4cebd49d92

It makes it easier to show your work to friends and your music production team. If you work with other guys, the Audio Player will make it easy to bounce ideas back and forth.

Anyway, I made this track 100% in Odesi using the sounds that come with the program. Enjoy making your own tunes and get your music published! You'll get inspired by using Odesi.

notes.title: Thank you for awesome feedback!
notes.content:
STEAM FANS! We love you!! Thank you for giving us feedback on what we should develop next. We created a roadmap based on your feedback, and here are the new features COMING SOON to Odesi for [b]free[/b]:

[list]
[*]Arpeggiators
[*]Audio import so you can work with an acapella
[*]Comprehensive guide on how to make unique music without presets
[*]Grooves and swing so drums don't sound too robotic
[*]Humanization of MIDI input
[*]Melody sketch generators
[*]Better Mixer user interface - it's almost done, just need to launch it soon
[*]Song structure - being able to create verse/chorus/break structure and rearrange the pieces quickly
[/list]

If you guys have feedback, feel free to post on the Community Hub. Enjoy using Odesi and create some kickass music for your projects!

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Odesi Music Composition
notes.content:
Odesi Music Composition is Now Available on Steam!

ODESI is a music sketchpad that exports your projects to Audio and MIDI
Create your next album in Odesi

Odesi helps you write hot tracks. It exports the results to Audio and MIDI files, so you can use the final result immediately. The MIDI files you create in Odesi will open perfectly inside Ableton Live, Logic Pro, Reason, Pro Tools, or any other DAW. It doesn’t change your workflow, it just speeds up your creative process because MIDI functions in Odesi are much faster than all music producer software.
